treaty_name: Agreement between the Sultanate of Oman and the Portuguese Republic for the avoidance of double taxation and the prevention of fiscal evasion with respect to taxes on income (2015)
eif_quote: SULTANATO DE OMÃ Resolução da Assembleia da República n.º 128/2016 ... Aviso n.º 80/2017 publicado em 06-07-2017 EM VIGOR DESDE 26-07-2016
source_title: Oman Tax Authority: Agreement Oman-Portugal (English text with Protocol)

rates.quote: but if the beneficial owner of the dividends is a resident of the other Contracting State, the tax so charged shall not exceed: b) 10 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends if the beneficial owner is a company (other than a partnership) which holds directly at least 10 per cent of the capital of the company paying the dividends;
c) 15 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends in all other cases.

However, such interest may also be taxed in the Contracting State in which it arises and according to the laws of that State, but if the beneficial owner of the interest is a resident of the other Contracting State, the tax so charged shall not exceed 10 per cent of the gross amount of the interest.

However, such royalties may also be taxed in the Contracting State in which they arise and according to the laws of that State, but if the beneficial owner of the royalties is a resident of the other Contracting State, the tax so charged shall not exceed 8 per cent of the gross amount of the royalties.

ppt.quote: it is understood that the provisions of the Agreement shall not apply if it was the main purpose or one of the main purposes of any person concerned with the creation or assignment of the property or right in respect of which the income is paid to take advantage of those provisions by means of such creation or assignment.

notes: Art. 10(2)(a): 5% cap on dividends beneficially owned by the State/subdivisions/local authorities/Central Bank of Portugal, or the Government of Oman, Central Bank of Oman, State General Reserve Fund, Omani Investment Fund (and other wholly government-owned statutory bodies as agreed) - government tier, not modelled. Art. 11(3): interest to those same public bodies taxable only in the residence State - not modelled. Art. 29: WHT effective from 1 January following EIF in both States (EIF 2016-07-26 -> 2017-01-01). Protocol 1 contains a treaty-level main-purpose rule (used as ppt basis) and beneficial-owner requirement. MLI: Portugal lists the Oman treaty and notified it under Art. 8(4); Oman's MLI position is a scanned PDF that could not be read, so MLI coverage (treaty map: mli_covered_both null), an MLI PPT date and any MLI Art. 8 365-day holding period for the 10% tier are not established.
